acceptanceCriteria: Two PRs that each add a build-log entry merge in either order without a text conflict.
Existing BUILD-LOG.md entries stay readable at stable paths, and the agent routes (AGENTS.md, docs/AGENT-ROUTES.md) point to the new location.
body: Filed 2026-09-25. Nearly every PR appends to the end of docs/BUILD-LOG.md, so after each merge every other open PR conflicts. GitHub runs no CI on a conflicting PR, and resolving the conflict restarts the full go-product run (about 70 minutes before V1-0357). On 2026-09-25 this forced integration PR #253 to combine #242, #246, #248, #250 and #252, and #245 needed a second merge. Options: one file per entry under docs/build-log/ with an index generated by make, or a union merge driver (.gitattributes merge=union) for the log. The generated-index option also keeps the log searchable by heading.
